instruction: Using Visual Studio Code, create a Python script named `premier_league_team_regression.py` in the `/home/user/analysis_results/sports_stats/` directory. In this script: (1) Scrape team statistics from `https://fbref.com/en/comps/9/Premier-League-Stats` for the ongoing season — include columns: `Team`, `Goals`, `Assists`, `Shots`, `Possession%`, `Pass%`. (2) Fit a linear regression model predicting `Points` (or Wins if Points not available) using the numeric stats. (3) Save a CSV named `premier_league_team_summary.csv` with the extracted data and predicted points. (4) Compute model R² and RMSE, saving them in a text file named `premier_league_regression_summary.txt` formatted exactly as: `R2: <value>, RMSE: <value>`.
